hero.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original premium enterprise cloud platform website hero artwork, no text. Create a breathtaking architectural abstract sculpture representing many infrastructure layers becoming one control plane. A precise upright flowing ribbon folded into three interlocking tall arches, made from translucent deep cobalt optical glass with a finely ribbed brushed aluminum internal core. The arch stack sits on a very thin dark graphite rectangular base, photographed like a luxury industrial object in a pale cool gray studio. One luminous electric-blue conduit sweeps through the arches. Restrained, sophisticated, tangible, editorial art direction, photorealistic ray-traced materials, soft daylight from upper left, beautiful contact shadows, delicate caustics. Subject dominates center and right in a landscape 3:2 composition, with generous clean background at left. Colors deep ink navy #0a1530, electric cobalt #2458f5, icy glass and brushed silver; background #f5f7fb. Crisp sculptural silhouette, excellent detail. No toy clouds, miniature buildings, servers, plants, floating UI, text, letters, logos, chart, people or watermark. This is abstract brand artwork, not a depiction of a real facility.
